attributes.text: So Asha never misses a reminder
A settings page opens. Turn on 'Alarms & reminders' for Asha, then come back.
3. Stop battery saver from muting Asha
In the list, find Asha and choose 'Don't optimise' or 'No restrictions'. Phones like Xiaomi, Vivo, Oppo and Realme need this most.
Pressure, pain into the arm or jaw, cold sweat, or breath you cannot catch is not something to wait out.
